Name: The Big Cat Mod
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Roszpunka1990 gave me permission to use her assets from her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24697]Pet Lion[/url] mod to make a new barn animal mod, so I present to you, the Big Cat mod!

This mod gives you 6 big cats to raise in your barns. They all produce claws and most will help you with rarer fish at high friendship levels. They are (and produce):

-Lions (gives claws and mane fur that can be turned into yarn)
-Lionesses (claws and lingcods)
-Tigers (claws and tiger trouts)
-Panthers (claws and dorados)
-Snow leopards (claws and ice pips)
-Cheetahs (claws and sturgeons)
﻿
Same install as usual, download and drop into your mod folder. 

Enjoy!
